ucs.title: [LLM] Famous Chollima 'Contagious Interview' — node.exe spawning curl/python to BeaverTail/InvisibleFerret staging infra
ucs.description: Hunts the BeaverTail (JS stealer) → InvisibleFerret (Python backdoor) chain that Famous Chollima (CrowdStrike) / UNC5342 (Mandiant) / DEV-0139-overlap delivers via trojanized npm packages and fake interview 'coding tests'. Pivots on Node.js / npm spawning curl or python with the campaign's hard-coded staging URLs, drop paths and signature SSH-over-port-1224 C2 strings.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("node.exe","Node.exe","npm.exe","npm-cli.js","npx.exe","npx-cli.js") AND Processes.process_name IN ("curl.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","pythonw.exe","cmd.exe","powershell.exe","wscript.exe") AND (Processes.process IN ("*api.npoint.io*","*ipcheck.cloud*","*ip-api.com*","*.n2/pdown*","*.n2\\pdown*","*\\AppData\\Roaming\\.n2*","*p.py*","*p2.py*","*pay.py*","*brow.py*","*mlip.py*","*ssh -p 1224*","*:1224*","*:1244*") OR match(Processes.process,"(?i)https?://[^\\s]+/(p2?\\.py|pay|brow|mlip|helper)(\\?|$|\\s)")) AND NOT Processes.user IN ("*$","SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE") by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let ChollimaIOCs = dynamic(["api.npoint.io","ipcheck.cloud","ip-api.com",".n2/pdown",".n2\\pdown","\\AppData\\Roaming\\.n2","p.py","p2.py","pay.py","brow.py","mlip.py","helper.py","ssh -p 1224",":1224",":1244"]); // BeaverTail config-staging, InvisibleFerret drop paths + signature C2 port
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("node.exe","npm.exe","npx.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("curl.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","pythonw.exe","cmd.exe","powershell.exe","wscript.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (ChollimaIOCs)
   or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)https?://[^\s]+/(p2?\.py|pay|brow|mlip|helper)(\?|$|\s)"
| where AccountName !endswith "$"      // exclude machine accounts
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          NodeParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          NodeParentFolder = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ChildBinary = FileName,
          ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine,
          StagingUrl = extract(@"(?i)(https?://[a-z0-9.:/_\-]+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine),
          SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let ChollimaIOCs = dynamic(["api.npoint.io","ipcheck.cloud","ip-api.com",".n2/pdown",".n2\\pdown","\\AppData\\Roaming\\.n2","p.py","p2.py","pay.py","brow.py","mlip.py","ssh -p 1224",":1224",":1244"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName has_any ("node.exe","npm.exe","npx.exe")
| extend ChildBin = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName,"\\")[-1]))
| where ChildBin in ("curl.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","pythonw.exe","cmd.exe","powershell.exe","wscript.exe")
| where CommandLine has_any (ChollimaIOCs)
   or CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)https?://[^\s]+/(p2?\.py|pay|brow|mlip|helper)(\?|$|\s)"
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName,
          ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine,
          StagingUrl = extract(@"(?i)(https?://[a-z0-9.:/_\-]+)", 1, CommandLine)
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Famous Chollima BeaverTail/InvisibleFerret Node-to-Curl-or-Python Chain
id: 9b8b3b4f-6cf3-4f4e-bf65-c4f0aab2c20a
status: experimental
description: Detects the DPRK Famous Chollima 'Contagious Interview' chain where a trojanized npm package or interview project (node/npm/npx parent) spawns curl or Python referencing BeaverTail config staging hosts, the InvisibleFerret .n2/pdown drop path, or the signature SSH-over-port-1224 C2.
references:
  - https://www.crowdstrike.com/blog/famous-chollima-targeting-developers/
  - https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/dprk-contagious-interview-beavertail-invisibleferret/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026-06-15
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1059.006
  - attack.t1059.007
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1105
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1195.001
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  parent_node:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\node.exe'
      - '\npm.exe'
      - '\npx.exe'
  child_lolbin:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\python.exe'
      - '\python3.exe'
      - '\pythonw.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
  chollima_ioc:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'api.npoint.io'
      - 'ipcheck.cloud'
      - 'ip-api.com'
      - '.n2/pdown'
      - '.n2\pdown'
      - '\AppData\Roaming\.n2'
      - 'p.py'
      - 'p2.py'
      - 'pay.py'
      - 'brow.py'
      - 'mlip.py'
      - 'ssh -p 1224'
      - ':1224'
      - ':1244'
  condition: parent_node and child_lolbin and chollima_ioc
falsepositives:
  - Developers manually invoking curl/python from a Node REPL — uncommon and never targeting these specific paths/ports
level: high
ucs.datadog_query:
source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*
ode.exe OR *\Node.exe OR *\NODE.EXE OR *
pm.exe OR *\NPM.EXE OR *
px.exe OR *\NPX.EXE) @Image:(*\curl.exe OR *\CURL.EXE OR *\python.exe OR *\Python.exe OR *\python3.exe OR *\pythonw.exe OR *\PYTHONW.EXE OR *\cmd.exe OR *\CMD.EXE OR *\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\wscript.exe OR *\WScript.exe) @CommandLine:(*api.npoint.io* OR *ipcheck.cloud* OR *ip-api.com* OR *.n2/pdown* OR *.n2\pdown* OR *\AppData\Roaming\.n2* OR *p.py* OR *p2.py* OR *pay.py* OR *brow.py* OR *mlip.py* OR *"ssh -p 1224"* OR *:1224* OR *:1244*) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/^(node|npm|npx)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(curl|python|python3|pythonw|cmd|powershell|wscript)\.exe$/i
| regex("(api\\.npoint\\.io|ipcheck\\.cloud|ip-api\\.com|\\.n2[\\\\/]pdown|\\\\AppData\\\\Roaming\\\\\\.n2|p2?\\.py|pay\\.py|brow\\.py|mlip\\.py|ssh\\s+-p\\s+1224|:1224|:1244)", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| NOT (UserName=/.+\$$/)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, SHA256HashData], function=count())
ucs.rationale: Specific to Famous Chollima rather than generic LOLBin abuse: (1) parent must be a Node ecosystem binary, which is the campaign's vector — trojanized npm packages (BeaverTail) delivered through the 'Contagious Interview' / Wagemole job-fraud lure; (2) child must drop or fetch one of the campaign's hard-coded IOCs — `api.npoint.io` staging, `.n2/pdown` InvisibleFerret drop directory, `p.py`/`p2.py`

ucs.title: [LLM] Famous Chollima DPRK IT Worker — RMM install on corp endpoint correlated with sign-in from Astrill/residential-proxy or DPRK-aligned geo
ucs.description: Hunts the Famous Chollima 'IT worker' insider scheme where DPRK operatives placed as remote engineers/contractors RDP into corp-issued laptops via residential VPN (Astrill is the canonical tell) and stand up RMM tooling — AnyDesk, Chrome Remote Desktop, RustDesk, ScreenConnect — for persistent hands-on-keyboard from Pyongyang. Joins a successful Entra sign-in from a suspect ASN / KP-aligned geo to an RMM-tool process on the same identity within a 6h window.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as proc_first max(_time) as proc_last from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("anydesk.exe","AnyDesk.exe","AnyDeskMSI.exe","ChromeRemoteDesktopHost.exe","remoting_host.exe","TeamViewer.exe","teamviewer.exe","TeamViewer_Service.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe","RustDesk.exe","rustdesk.exe","quickassist.exe") AND NOT Processes.user IN ("*$","SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rename user as auth_user | join type=inner auth_user [ | tstats `summariesonly` min(_time) as signin_time from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.action=success AND (Authentication.src_country IN ("KP","CN","RU","LA") OR Authentication.user_agent IN ("*Astrill*","*ExpressVPN*") OR Authentication.app="Azure Active Directory PowerShell") by Authentication.user Authentication.src Authentication.src_country | `drop_dm_object_name(Authentication)` | rename user as auth_user ] | where proc_first >= signin_time AND proc_first <= signin_time + 21600 | eval delay_min=round((proc_first-signin_time)/60,1) | convert ctime(signin_time) ctime(proc_first) ctime(proc_last) | sort - signin_time
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
let WindowAfterSignIn = 6h;
let RmmBinaries = dynamic(["AnyDesk.exe","AnyDeskMSI.exe","ChromeRemoteDesktopHost.exe","remoting_host.exe","TeamViewer.exe","TeamViewer_Service.exe","ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe","ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe","RustDesk.exe","quickassist.exe"]);
let SuspectSignIns = AADSignInEventsBeta
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ErrorCode == 0
    | where Country in ("KP","CN","RU","LA")           // KP-aligned tasking geos
         or UserAgent has_any ("Astrill","ExpressVPN")  // residential-proxy tells
         or IsAnonymousProxy == true
    | project SignInTime = Timestamp, AccountUpn, IPAddress, Country, UserAgent;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where FileName in~ (RmmBinaries)
   or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("msiexec.exe","setup.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("AnyDesk","ChromeRemoteDesktop","RustDesk","ScreenConnect","TeamViewer")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| join kind=inner SuspectSignIns on $left.AccountUpn == $right.AccountUpn
| where Timestamp between (SignInTime .. SignInTime + WindowAfterSignIn)
| project SignInTime, RmmTime = Timestamp,
          DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', Timestamp, SignInTime),
          DeviceName, AccountUpn,
          SignInIP = IPAddress, SignInCountry = Country, SignInUA = UserAgent,
          RmmBinary = FileName,
          RmmCmd = ProcessCommandLine
| order by SignInTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 30d;
let WindowAfterSignIn = 6h;
let RmmBinaries = dynamic(["anydesk.exe","anydeskmsi.exe","chromeremotedesktophost.exe","remoting_host.exe","teamviewer.exe","teamviewer_service.exe","screenconnect.clientservice.exe","screenconnect.windowsclient.exe","rustdesk.exe","quickassist.exe"]);
let SuspectSignIns = SigninLogs
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where ResultType == 0
    | extend Country = tostring(LocationDetails.countryOrRegion)
    | where Country in ("KP","CN","RU","LA")
         or UserAgent has_any ("Astrill","ExpressVPN")
    | project SignInTime = TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, Country, UserAgent;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend ProcName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName,"\\")[-1]))
| where ProcName in (RmmBinaries)
   or CommandLine has_any ("AnyDesk","ChromeRemoteDesktop","RustDesk","ScreenConnect","TeamViewer")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend Upn = strcat(tolower(SubjectUserName),"@",tolower(SubjectDomainName))
| join kind=inner (SuspectSignIns | extend Upn = tolower(UserPrincipalName)) on Upn
| where TimeGenerated between (SignInTime .. SignInTime + WindowAfterSignIn)
| project SignInTime, RmmTime = TimeGenerated,
          DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', TimeGenerated, SignInTime),
          Computer, Upn,
          SignInIP = IPAddress, SignInCountry = Country, SignInUA = UserAgent,
          RmmBinary = NewProcessName, RmmCmd = CommandLine
| order by SignInTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: (source:azure.activeDirectory @evt.name:"Sign-in activity" @properties.status.errorCode:0 (@network.client.geoip.country.iso_code:(KP OR CN OR RU OR LA) OR @http.useragent:(*Astrill* OR *ExpressVPN*))) OR (source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\AnyDesk.exe OR *\anydesk.exe OR *\AnyDeskMSI.exe OR *\ChromeRemoteDesktopHost.exe OR *\remoting_host.exe OR *\TeamViewer.exe OR *\teamviewer.exe OR *\TeamViewer_Service.exe OR *\ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe OR *\ScreenConnect.WindowsClient.exe OR *\RustDesk.exe OR *\rustdesk.exe OR *\quickassist.exe) -@User:*$)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(AnyDesk|AnyDeskMSI|ChromeRemoteDesktopHost|remoting_host|TeamViewer|TeamViewer_Service|ScreenConnect\.(ClientService|WindowsClient)|RustDesk|quickassist)\.exe$/i
| NOT (UserName=/.+\$$/)
| join({
    #event_simpleName=UserLogon
    | LogonType=10 OR (RemoteAddressIP4=* AND NOT cidr("10.0.0.0/8", field=RemoteAddressIP4) AND NOT cidr("172.16.0.0/12", field=RemoteAddressIP4) AND NOT cidr("192.168.0.0/16", field=RemoteAddressIP4))
  }, field=[aid, UserName], include=[LogonType, RemoteAddressIP4, LogonTime])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, RemoteAddressIP4], function=[count(), min(_time, as=firstRmm)])
ucs.rationale: This is the Famous Chollima IT-worker tradecraft straight out of the DOJ indictments and the CrowdStrike / Mandiant (UNC5267) reporting on DPRK IT-worker placement: Pyongyang operatives sit behind Astrill or comparable residential-VPN egress, RDP into a corp-issued laptop (often hosted at a US-based 'laptop farm'), then immediately deploy AnyDesk / Chrome Remote Desktop / RustDesk so they can come
